<!--
Thank you for contributing to Kemlock-core! Please read CONTRIBUTING.md first.
-->

What this changes, and why:

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`fix(vault): ...`). A `feat` or `fix` is a line of the release's notes.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`). A coding agent never signs off for you.
- [ ] A change of behaviour comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] No byte format changes (vault, export, sync file, kem1, manifest, OPAQUE), or a version label and a fixture prove that old data still opens. No fixture or test vector is regenerated or edited.
- [ ] README.md, CLAUDE.md or docs/ are changed with what they describe.
- [ ] Anything copied from another project says where from, with its licence.
